parameters.name: AttackInstance
parameters.description: The attacked asset. You can specify the machine instance name, public IP address, or private IP address.

parameters.name: AttackType
parameters.description:
The attack type. Valid values:
- 9: SQL Server brute-force attack
- 5: SSH brute-force attack
- 6: RDP brute-force attack
- 101: Java Struts2 attack interception
- 102: Redis attack interception
- 103: China Chopper (AntSword) WebShell communication
- 104: China Chopper (Caidao) WebShell communication
- 133: XISE WebShell communication
- 161: WebShell upload
- 209: PHP WebShell upload
- 210: JSP WebShell upload
- 211: ASP WebShell upload
- 215: WebShell upload with special suffix
- ai_webshell: intelligent WebShell upload defense
- java_common_rce: Java common RCE vulnerability interception
- alinet_webrce: adaptive web attack defense

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page to return in a paged query.

parameters.name: DstPort
parameters.description: The destination port of the attack.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the end time.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paged query.

parameters.name: SrcIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the attack.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the start time.
